title: Create the repository and add the team
description: Create the GitHub repo, add the whole team (Somos F5 and Ebury) and protect main so pull requests are required.
done_when: Repo created, everyone has access and main is protected.

title: Push the project skeleton and review the README
description: Push the unzipped project with a descriptive first commit and review the README.
done_when: Code on main and a readable README.

title: Create the GitHub Project (board) with statuses and views
description: Statuses Backlog, Ready, In progress, In review and Done. Views: by status, a table grouped by milestone and one view per person (filter by owner label).
done_when: Board created and shared with the team.

title: Agree on working conventions (CONTRIBUTING.md)
description: Short branches per task, descriptive commits, PRs with at least one review and a definition of done.

title: Create the team's Groq key and document the limits
description: Create an account and API key at console.groq.com, choose a model with tool-use support and note the usage limits. The key goes in a secrets manager, never in Git.
done_when: Key created; model and limits written down in docs/decisions.md.

title: Verify the prepared Docker stack on every machine
description: The Docker Compose setup is already prepared: each person starts it (cp .env.example .env and docker compose up --build) and confirms it works. Sort out WSL, licences or ports.
done_when: All 4 people see the app on localhost:3000.

title: Confirm with Ebury: gender angle, DEGU source and priority region
description: Ask the PO whether the approach without a gender angle is accepted, whether DEGU exists as a data source and which autonomous community to prioritise.

title: Probe access to BDNS and FEGA (API, downloads and limits)
description: Find out which open data exists, its formats, filters and limits, and save a downloaded sample.
done_when: Note with the usable sources in docs/data_sources.md and a saved sample.

title: First push: fix the backend CI failures
description: Run pytest and fix import errors, schemas or tests (the code has not been run yet).

title: Run and fix the Postgres integration tests
description: Run tests/test_db.py against local Postgres and against the CI one.
done_when: test_db passes locally and in CI.

title: Fix the frontend build and tests and generate package-lock.json
description: npm install, npm test and npm run build. Commit the lockfile and switch to npm ci in the Dockerfile and the CI.
done_when: Frontend job is green and the lockfile is in Git.

title: Make the Docker Compose smoke test pass in CI
description: Part of the Docker preparation: health must report data_source postgres and nginx must forward /api.

title: First real Groq call: verify function calling
description: Try POST /api/chat with the Teruel case, check that it picks and chains tools, and tune model, temperature and retries.
done_when: Demo case 1 returns an answer with a trace.

title: Define the list of candidate aids (6-8 to implement)
description: List by category (CAP livestock, start-up, modernization, insurance, animal health) with the candidate official URL of each. Prioritise 6-8 to implement.

title: Shared sheet template and export script to aids.json
description: Columns of the data schema and a script that validates with Pydantic and exports.

title: Reusable blocks: active farmer, conditionality and young farmer
description: Write them from the current rules (BOE and FEGA), with sources and verified thresholds.

title: Aid records: CAP direct payments and eco-schemes
description: Requirements, steps, documents, deadline and source for each aid. Reduced scope: only the most relevant ones.
done_when: At least 3 aids loaded and validated.

title: Aid records: livestock coupled support by livestock type
description: One record per relevant coupled aid (cattle, sheep, goat...). Reduced scope: only the most relevant ones.
done_when: At least 3 aids loaded and validated.

title: Aid records: young farmers start-up and modernization
description: National and regional start-up and farm investment aids.
done_when: At least 2 aids loaded and validated.

title: Aid records: agricultural insurance and animal health
description: Insurance subsidies and animal health aids.
done_when: At least 2 aids loaded and validated.

title: Aid records: the chosen autonomous community
description: Regional depth according to the decision in F0-07.

title: Cross-verification, batch 1 (CAP)
description: Check the F2-04 records against the original document; mark them verified and fill in verified_by.

title: Cross-verification, batch 2 (livestock aids)
description: Check the F2-05 records against the original document (verified by someone other than the author).

title: Load the base into Postgres and review /api/aids
description: Run python -m app.db.seed and review every aid through the API.

title: Define 8-10 agent evaluation cases
description: Profile, question, expected tools and expected result. Include out-of-scope and manipulation cases.

title: Evaluation script against the backend
description: Runs the cases, stores answer and trace, and flags whether it used the expected tools and whether it cited non-existent aids.
done_when: Script that produces a pass/fail report.

title: Tune the system prompt with real cases and examples with real aids
description: Time-boxed session: iterate on the traces with the evaluation cases and replace the fictitious examples with aids from the base.

title: Improve tool descriptions and colloquial-language normalisation
description: Make the model map 'ovejas' to sheep, 'vacas de carne' to cattle, etc., and choose the right tool.

title: Improve search_aids ranking with the real base
description: Tune scoring by goal, production system and free text, with tests on real cases.
done_when: Relevant aids appear in the top 3.

title: Adapt find_alternatives and get_application_guide to the real data
description: Review outputs with real aids and fill in missing data.

title: Extend /api/chat with requirements and missing data per aid
description: Return the evaluated requirement details so the frontend can show them; update models and tests.

title: Test Groq's limits and friendly error messages
description: Trigger rate limits and errors and check the messages.
done_when: Clear errors and no silent failures.

title: Manipulation tests (prompt injection) and out-of-scope requests
description: Try to make the agent ignore its rules or talk about other topics.

title: Review the app in the browser with the real backend and fix bugs
description: Go through every flow: profile, chat, panels, new conversation.
done_when: No console errors in the main flows.

title: Show requirement details per aid (met, missing, to confirm)
description: Panel with each requirement and the missing data.
done_when: Details visible for every evaluated aid.

title: Responsive design and accessibility (mobile, keyboard, contrast)
description: Test on mobile, with a keyboard and with a screen reader.
done_when: No blocking issues on mobile or keyboard.

title: Loading and error states; test offline and timeouts
description: Review messages and make sure typed text is not lost.
done_when: Clear errors in all the cases tested.

title: Review the UI texts for plain language with the PO
description: Short session with the PO to simplify the language.

title: React component tests
description: Tests for ProfileForm, Chat and ResultPanels.

title: Choose a platform with Docker support and create a managed Postgres
description: Compare Render, Railway and Fly.io for Docker support and managed database.

title: Deploy the prepared containers (backend, frontend and Postgres)
description: With the Docker images already prepared: environment variables on the platform, ALLOWED_ORIGINS and VITE_API_BASE if the frontend lives on another domain, and a /api/health check.
done_when: Full application reachable at a public URL.

title: Deployment pipeline with GitHub Actions
description: Deploy from main or manually, with the secrets stored in GitHub.
done_when: A push to main deploys, or there is a manual button.

title: Rate limiting and security review
description: Per-IP request limit, review of secrets, CORS and ports.

title: Final README with the SDG justification and a real data point
description: README draft with the SDGs and the real data point; final tweaks on the event day.

title: Find a real supporting data point (rural digital divide or reliance on paid agents)
description: An official, citable report or figure for the justification.
done_when: Data point and source written down in docs/.

title: Technical documentation: endpoints, tools, prompt and 3 examples with trace
description: Copy 3 real interactions with their trace into docs/examples.md.

title: Event-day timeboxing plan
description: Fit the plan into the reference agenda (09:50-12:30 and 13:00 until about 15:30) and split the day's tasks.

title: Demo script (3 cases) and sample data
description: Draft before the event with the cases: young extensive-sheep farmer, farmer who does not qualify and application-procedure question. Adjusted with the final prompt and UI during the rehearsal (F6-04).
done_when: Script tested with the real app.

title: Presentation: problem, SDGs, solution, architecture and lessons learned
description: Draft before the event: problem, SDGs, solution, architecture and lessons learned.

title: One timed demo rehearsal
description: Rehearse the whole demo with a timer and speaking turns (8-10 minutes).
done_when: One rehearsal within the time limit.

title: Plan B: screenshots or video of the demo and service warm-up
description: In case the network or the provider fails; warm up the services before presenting.

title: Freeze the code and tag v1.0 before the presentations
description: Tag v1.0 and make no more changes until after the demo.

title: BDNS ingestion script into Postgres
description: Download, normalise and load calls with metadata_only reliability.

title: Model budgeted, granted and paid amounts
description: Extend the schema and warn when the figure is not available.

title: distribution_analyzer tool
description: Group amounts by territory and purpose, with careful wording.
done_when: Tool with tests and registered in the agent.

title: Text search over the regulatory rules
description: Index the text and use it for aids with free-form goals.
done_when: Measurable improvement on the evaluation cases.

title: Distribution charts in the frontend
description: Show the results of distribution_analyzer.
